theater: 亞美尼亞高原阿爾塔克沙特

battle.name: 安東尼的安息戰爭
battle.theater: 亞美尼亞高原阿爾塔克沙特
battle.brief: 公元前40年，安東尼自敘利亞越卡帕多細亞入亞美尼亞，圍困叛離的舊都阿爾塔克沙特，俘國王阿爾塔瓦茲二世；再向安息埃克巴塔那推進，因後方受騎兵威脅回師，撤退時攻城器械與輜重盡失。卡面埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，與本役相隔三千年並不在現場；羅軍用皮魯姆標槍，安息用康托斯長槍與複合弓。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元前40年羅馬三頭同盟者安東尼對帕提亞王國與亞美尼亞聯軍的一次遠征，交戰地域在亞美尼亞高原與美索不達米亞的東緣。羅馬一方由安東尼以東方行省的絕對統帥身分指揮：他自敘利亞、奇里乞亞、卡帕多細亞與埃及調集兵員，以羅馬軍團為骨幹，輔以高盧、色雷斯、克里特、埃及與希臘裔的輔助部隊，並徵用科薩雷尼亞的加利西亞人等舊部，軍隊沿亞美尼亞的南北谷地展開。羅馬的指揮系統是軍團執令官、百夫長與什長構成的傳統鏈條，軍事保民官分掌行軍紀律與後勤，工程部隊操作攻城器械，糧秣則靠隨軍車隊與沿途徵發。安息一方是帕提亞王國，國王奧羅德斯二世坐鎮塞西豐與埃克巴塔那，以重裝騎兵與弓箭騎兵見長，國王的兒子帕科魯斯統率前線部隊。亞美尼亞在名義上附庸安息，國王阿爾塔瓦茲二世在公元前40年公開叛離羅馬並引安息兵入境，亞美尼亞貴族與部分守軍站在安息一方；此外仍有塞琉古系小國與龐培舊部的殘餘武裝在亞美尼亞境內活動。羅馬與安息之間沒有正式宣戰，衝突以王位爭端與附庸秩序崩解的形式爆發。
countriesEn: This war was a Roman expedition launched in 40 BC by Mark Antony, one of the three triumvirs, against the Parthian (Arsacid) kingdom and an allied Armenian force; the fighting took place on the Armenian plateau and along the eastern margins of Mesopotamia. The Roman side was commanded by Antony in his capacity as supreme commander of the eastern provinces: he drew troops from Syria, Cilicia, Cappadocia and Egypt, built his army on the framework of the Roman legions, and supplemented it with Gallic, Thracian, Cretan, Egyptian and Greek contingents, together with former Pompeian troops such as the Galatian recruits of the Galatians. The Roman command structure remained the traditional chain of legate, centurion and optio, with military tribunes handling march discipline and supply, engineers operating the siege train, and grain and provisions carried by the baggage trains and gathered along the route. The Parthian side was the Arsacid kingdom under King Orodes II, who based himself at Ctesiphon and Ecbatana and was renowned for cataphracts and mounted archers, while his son Pacorus led the field forces. Armenia stood nominally under Arsacid influence: King Artavasdes II openly revolted from Rome in 40 BC and brought Parthian troops into the country, and the Armenian nobility and part of the garrison sided with Parthia. Minor Seleucid states and remnants of Pompeian forces were also active inside Armenia. There was no formal declaration of war between Rome and Parthia; the clash took the form of a dispute over a royal succession and the breakdown of the client order.
people: 核心人物是安東尼本人。安東尼此時五十多歲，是三頭同盟中掌控東方的人，剛在公元前41年取得埃及，準備以亞歷山大為基地經營東方帝國；他的女兒安東尼婭於公元前40年在亞美尼亞境內難產身亡，產下的女兒隨即夭折，一說死因為中毒，負責照顧的克莉奧佩特拉七世因此被指為嫌疑人，這段宮廷指控出自敵意敘述，但確實把阿爾塔瓦茲二世推到了安東尼的敵對位置。亞美尼亞王阿爾塔瓦茲二世是直接對手，他長期在位，既維持與羅馬的臣屬關係又利用羅馬在東方的空檔與安息往來，叛羅之後在阿爾塔克沙特被俘；安東尼對他以禮相待，翌年放他回國，其子提格列斯四世則在往後的亞美尼亞王位安排中取代他。安息國王奧羅德斯二世未親至前線，遙控戰局；其子帕科魯斯以善用騎兵著稱，是安息方面的行動核心，兩年後在吉爾達魯斯山被安東尼陣營擊殺。安東尼的部將索西烏斯是他倚重的前線將領，負責野戰的實際執行，並在亞美尼亞長期擔任安東尼的代理人；被俘的亞美尼亞貴族中有人倒向安東尼，在攻城階段扮演內應的角色。
peopleEn: The central figure is Antony himself. Now in his fifties, he was the member of the triumvirs who controlled the East, had just taken Egypt in 41 BC and was building an eastern empire on the model of Alexandria. His daughter Antonia died in 40 BC in Armenia in childbirth, and the infant girl she bore died as well; poisoning is one of the explanations given, and Cleopatra VII, who had been responsible for her care, was blamed for it. The accusation comes from a hostile narrative, but it did place Artavasdes II squarely among Antony's enemies. The king of Armenia was the direct opponent: Artavasdes had ruled for a long time, keeping up at once his subordinate relationship with Rome and his contacts with Parthia, and after his revolt he was captured at Artaxata. Antony treated him with honour and released him the following year, and his son Tigranes IV later took the Armenian throne under Antony's arrangement. The Parthian king Orodes II did not come to the front in person but steered the campaign from the rear; his son Pacorus, famous for his use of cavalry, was the operational core on the Arsacid side and was killed by Antony's camp two years later at Mount Gindarus. Antony's lieutenant Sosius was one of the officers he relied on most in the field, carried out the actual operations, and remained Antony's man in Armenia for years. Among the captured Armenian nobles some turned to Antony and played the part of insiders during the siege.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬青銅時代工藝：早王朝的青銅矛頭以繩或皮條縛在木杆上，形制簡陋，用來守城垣，也用來收復失地。它並不在公元前40年的戰場上，與本役相隔約三千年，羅馬與安息士兵手裡握的是更晚的鐵器長矛。同期羅馬步兵的骨幹裝備是皮魯姆這種重標槍，槍身長約兩米，槍頭與槍杆同為鐵製，可由擲槍機或徒手擲出，兼具壓制騎兵與纏鬥的功能；近身則用短矛與雙刃劍，盾配卡帕多細亞式圓盾或伊利里亞式橢圓盾，重裝單位另有鐵環甲。攻城方面羅馬投入攻城塔、撞槌、投石機與配重投石機，這批器械在公元前40年的撤退中全部失去。安息方面，主力裝備是重騎兵的康托斯長槍，即以木杆加鐵尖、可用槍尾輔助衝鋒的重矛，騎士披鱗甲或鎖子甲，連人帶馬披重甲；其步兵與弓手用小型弓、標槍與柳條盾。兩軍都使用複合弓與箭袋，安息弓兵以彎弓配重箭，射程與射速都勝過羅馬的輕裝弓兵。坐騎方面，安息重騎兵依賴尼西亞馬，這種馬出自美索不達米亞東緣的高原牧場，耐力與負重俱佳；羅馬遠征的糧秣靠牛車與四輪馬車混用的車隊輸送，車隊在山路上往往決定全軍的行軍速度。卡面長矛值得注意的不是作戰性能，而是它在埃及代表的那種象徵：它屬於王朝重建時期用來守住城牆的器物，恰好映照本役的性質——安東尼在亞美尼亞要靠攻城器械攻下一座城，而不是靠一次野戰解決問題。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card belongs to Bronze Age craft: an early dynastic bronze head bound to a wooden shaft with cord or thong, a simple form used to hold city walls and to win back lost ground. It was not on the battlefield of 40 BC, roughly three thousand years away from this campaign, and the long lances in the hands of Roman and Parthian soldiers were later iron weapons. The backbone of the Roman infantryman's equipment at this time was the pilum, a heavy javelin about two metres long, with both shaft and head of iron, thrown by a plumbata launcher or by hand, serving both to check cavalry and to fight at close quarters. At contact the Romans used the short hasta and the gladius, with the round scutum of the Cappadocian type or the oval shield of Illyrian type, and armoured troops also wore iron ring mail. For siege work Rome brought up towers, rams, onagers and traction trebuchets, and all of this equipment was lost during the withdrawal of 40 BC. On the Parthian side the principal arm was the kontos of the cataphracts, a heavy lance with a wooden shaft and an iron head that could be driven home with the butt end, the rider wearing scale or chain mail with the horse armoured as well; their foot soldiers and archers used smaller bows, javelins and wicker shields. Both armies used composite bows and quivers, and the Parthian archers drew a strong composite bow with weighted arrows, out-ranging and out-pacing the lighter Roman bowmen. In the matter of transport, the Parthian cataphracts relied on Nisean horses, bred on the upland pastures at the eastern edge of Mesopotamia and prized for stamina and carrying capacity, while the Romans moved their grain in a baggage train of ox carts and four-wheeled wagons mixed together, a convoy that on mountain roads often set the pace of the whole army. What matters about the card weapon is not its fighting performance but the symbol it stood for in Egypt: it was the tool of a dynasty-rebuilding age used to hold city walls, and that is precisely the character of this campaign, in which Antony had to take a walled city with siege engines rather than settle the matter in a single field battle.
tactics: 安東尼的整體戰術是先取節點，再向心臟推進。戰役在公元前40年入夏展開，他沿奇里乞亞與卡帕多細亞北上，翻越陶魯斯山脈進入亞美尼亞，選擇阿爾塔克沙特而不是別的城市作為首要目標，因為這座城是亞美尼亞的舊都與交通樞紐，控制它等於控制整個阿拉拉特平原的糧源與門戶。圍城階段他沒有急攻：築壘設營，把圍城線拉成環形，切斷城內與外界的水源和樵柴通道，同時以工程部隊把攻城塔與撞槌運到能使用的位置。阿爾塔克沙特以阿拉斯河的支流與環城水渠取水，圍城方必須先控制或改道水渠，才有可能把器械貼近城牆；城內守軍屍次出城反擊，圍城最終以亞美尼亞方面的屈服與部分貴族的內應收場，耗時以月計。安東尼接著放棄穩固的後方，率軍向埃克巴塔那方向強行推進，把補給線拉成數百公里長的一條線，縱隊與輜重車隊在山間谷地被迫拉成長條。安息騎兵沒有正面挑戰密集的羅馬步兵方陣，而是利用平原與山麓的速度反覆貼近：弓騎放箭擾亂行列，鎧甲騎兵選擇羅馬隊形拉開的缺口衝擊，尤其針對殿後的輜重隊、帳幕車隊與徵發的糧車下手。撤退時縱隊一旦被咬住，安東尼的部隊就停下轉為方陣與柵欄，這使羅軍免於崩潰，卻讓拖延戰的安息騎兵得以不斷游走破壞。安息騎兵在撤退途中最大的成果不是斬首，而是讓羅軍丟掉了攻城器械與全部輜重。
tacticsEn: Antony's method was to seize the hinge first and then drive towards the heart. The campaign opened in the early summer of 40 BC. He moved north through Cilicia and Cappadocia, crossed the Taurus range into Armenia, and chose Artaxata rather than another city as his first objective, because that city was the old capital of Armenia and its transport hub: holding it meant controlling the grain and the gateway of the whole Ararat plain. In the siege phase he did not rush. He built a fortified camp, drew the line of circumvallation into a ring, cut the city off from outside water and firewood, and at the same time worked the engineers to bring towers and rams into positions where they could be used. Artaxata drew its water from a branch of the Araxes and from a channel running around the walls, so the besiegers had to control or divert that channel before they could bring their engines close to the ramparts. The garrison repeatedly sallied out, and the siege finally ended with the Armenian side yielding and with the collusion of part of the nobility; it lasted a matter of months. Antony then gave up his secure rear and pressed on toward Ecbatana, stretching the supply line into a chain several hundred kilometres long, with the column and the baggage trains forced out into a long string in the valleys. The Parthian horse did not engage the massed Roman infantry in a frontal clash. They used the speed of the plain and the foothills to close in again and again: mounted archers showered arrows to disorder the ranks, armoured horsemen chose the gaps that opened when the Roman formation stretched, and they struck above all at the rearguard, the baggage train and the requisitioned supply carts. When the withdrawal began and the column was bitten, Antony's men halted and formed square and fence. That saved the army from collapse, but it allowed the harassing horse to keep riding round and breaking things up. The Parthians' greatest prize of the withdrawal was not a commander's head but the loss of the siege engines and the whole baggage train.
data: 本役留下來的數字不多，而且沒有一個可以當作確數。安東尼投入的總兵力在同時代文獻中沒有記載，學界一般只以數萬人概括，其中真正能投入野戰的羅馬軍團只是其中一部分，輔助部隊與盟友軍隊的數量無從核對；亞美尼亞與安息聯軍的兵力同樣沒有可靠數字。圍城時間在史料中只以數月概說。可核對的反而是地理數據：阿爾塔克沙特位於阿拉拉特平原，海拔約六百五十米；埃克巴塔那在札格羅斯山麓，海拔約一千八百五十米；兩城直線距離約六百七十公里，若沿谷地道路繞行則更遠，而這條路正是安東尼必須打通卻沒能走完的補給線。撤退時可以確定的是攻城器械與輜重全部失去，安東尼回到地中海東岸時已無任何攻城能力；步兵本體的損失沒有數字，古代作者只描述軍隊仍能整隊返回。關於羅軍的戰術編制，可推知的是其核心是步行方陣加上輔助騎兵，安息則是全騎兵化的衝擊集團，兩者的補給方式分別依賴車隊與馬匹，兩者在長距離行軍中的速度差正是本役勝負的關鍵。戰後的變化則有可查的節點：公元前38年帕科魯斯陣亡於吉爾達魯斯山，公元前39年安息與安東尼議和，安息歸還公元前53年克拉蘇部被繳的鷹旗。
dataEn: Few figures survive from this campaign, and none of them can be treated as exact. There is no record in contemporary literature of the total force Antony committed; scholarship generally puts it in the tens of thousands, of which the Roman legions ready for field action were only a part, and the numbers of the auxiliaries and allied contingents cannot be checked. The strength of the combined Armenian and Parthian army is likewise unknown. The duration of the siege is given only as a matter of months. What can be checked is geographical: Artaxata lies on the Ararat plain at about 650 metres above sea level, Ecbatana on the Zagros foothills at about 1,850 metres, and the two cities are roughly 670 kilometres apart in a straight line, more if the valley roads are followed; that road was the supply line Antony had to open and never finished. On losses it is certain that the siege train and the baggage were lost entire, and that Antony reached the eastern Mediterranean with no siege capability at all. There is no figure for the infantry itself, and ancient authors describe only that the army came back in order. The tactical organisation can be reconstructed: the Roman core was an infantry square supported by auxiliary cavalry, while the Parthian side was an all-mounted striking force, and the two drew their provisions in different ways, by wagon train and by horse respectively, so that the difference in their speed over long marches was the decisive factor of the campaign. The later course of the war, by contrast, has datable points: Pacorus was killed at Mount Gindarus in 38 BC, and in 39 BC Parthia made peace with Antony and returned the eagle standards captured from Crassus' army in 53 BC.
cause: 打起上來的直接原因有兩層，制度層面與私人層面纏在一起。制度層面是羅馬在東方的附庸秩序被打破：亞美尼亞自龐培時代起是羅馬的附庸王國，長期由阿爾塔瓦茲二世統治，他一方面維持與羅馬的臣屬關係，另一方面利用羅馬在東方的空檔與安息往來；到公元前40年，亞美尼亞宣布脫離安東尼的宗主權，並引安息軍隊入境，亞美尼亞山間的道路與高原草場一旦落入安息勢力，安息弓騎兵就能直接威脅卡帕多細亞、敘利亞北境與羅馬的通信線，這是安東尼不能容忍的。私人層面是家庭悲劇：安東尼與阿爾塔瓦茲二世所生的女兒安東尼婭於公元前40年在亞美尼亞難產而死，僅存的嬰孩也夭折；照顧她的克莉奧佩特拉七世被宮廷指控為下毒者，雖然這項指控充滿敵意，但它把阿爾塔瓦茲二世推到了安東尼的敵對位置。深層的原因則是安東尼自己的盤算：他在亞歷山大建立的東方王朝需要一場看得見的勝利來證明自己，在安息邊界上重畫勢力範圍，遠征亞美尼亞是他選定的第一步。
causeEn: There were two layers to the outbreak, an institutional one and a personal one, entangled with each other. The institutional layer was the breakdown of the Roman client order in the East: since the age of Pompey, Armenia had been a client kingdom of Rome, ruled for a long time by Artavasdes II, who kept up at once his subordinate relationship with Rome and his contacts with Parthia, using the gaps in Roman attention in the East. By 40 BC Armenia had declared itself released from Antony's overlordship and had brought Parthian troops into the country, and once the roads and the summer pastures of the Armenian highlands fell to Parthian influence, Parthian horse-archers could threaten Cappadocia, northern Syria and the Roman lines of communication directly. That was something Antony could not tolerate. The personal layer was a family tragedy: Antonia, the daughter Antony had had by Artavasdes II, died in 40 BC in Armenia in childbirth, and the only surviving child died as well. Cleopatra VII, who had been responsible for her care, was accused in the court of having poisoned her. The accusation was full of hostility, but it did place Artavasdes II squarely among Antony's enemies. Beneath both lay Antony's own calculation: the eastern dynasty he was building at Alexandria needed a victory that everyone could see, and redrawing the frontier with Parthia by way of a campaign in Armenia was the first step he chose.
impact: 遠征的失敗給安東尼的東方計劃留下三道裂痕。第一，羅馬沒有打開通往埃克巴塔那的道路，帕提亞得以保住美索不達米亞與亞美尼亞高原這段緩衝，兩國的實際分界線退回到幼發拉底河與亞美尼亞一帶，前線壓力轉移到羅馬一邊。第二，安東尼的軍隊雖保住了，攻城能力卻在一次撤退中全部折損，之後他只能靠重新調配與依靠盟友軍隊取得戰果；公元前38年在吉爾達魯斯山擊殺帕科魯斯、公元前39年迫使奧羅德斯二世議和，都建立在此役之後的長期消耗之上，而和約的主要內容之一是安息歸還克拉蘇部被繳的鷹旗，這在羅馬的輿論上是實質性的收復。第三，這場失敗加深了安東尼與屋大維之間的裂痕：他必須把大量時間與財力耗在東方戰線上，亞克興海戰之後，東方行省在政治上被重新分配給屋大維，帕提亞成為羅馬永久的邊界問題，兩國隨後又經歷了多次邊境戰爭，羅馬直到後期才真正放棄把美索不達米亞收入版圖的想法。安東尼在公元前41年扶植的埃及王朝，也在這場遠征與其後續消耗中耗盡了籌碼。
impactEn: The failure of the expedition left three cracks in Antony's eastern project. First, Rome had not opened the road to Ecbatana, and Parthia was able to keep Mesopotamia and the buffer of the Armenian plateau, so the effective frontier between the two powers fell back to the Euphrates and to Armenia and the pressure on the line moved onto the Roman side. Second, Antony's army survived, but its siege capability was destroyed in a single withdrawal, so afterwards he could win only by rebuilding his forces and leaning on allies. The killing of Pacorus at Mount Gindarus in 38 BC and the peace forced on Orodes II in 39 BC both rested on the long attrition that followed this campaign, and one of the main clauses of that peace was the return by Parthia of the eagle standards taken from Crassus' army, which counted in Roman public opinion as a real recovery. Third, the defeat deepened the rift between Antony and Octavian: Antony had to keep tying up time and money on the eastern front, and after Actium the eastern provinces were politically reallocated to Octavian, leaving Parthia as a permanent Roman frontier problem. The two powers fought along that border many times afterwards, and Rome only much later abandoned the idea of taking Mesopotamia into its own hands. The Egyptian dynasty Antony had established in 41 BC also spent its political capital in this campaign and in the exhaustion that followed.
result: 結果要分成戰術結果與戰役結果兩層。戰術上，安東尼拿下了阿爾塔克沙特：圍城以月計而告終，城門開啟，亞美尼亞王阿爾塔瓦茲二世與王室成員被俘，羅軍佔領了亞美尼亞的舊都，敵方在這場攻城戰裡丟失了城池與君主。戰役上則是完全的失敗：安東尼放棄向埃克巴塔那推進，撤退途中安息騎兵襲擊殿後與輜重隊，攻城塔、撞槌、投石機與全部糧秣車隊被毀或被奪，羅軍回到地中海東岸時已無攻城能力，安息本土與美索不達米亞沒有被觸及，安東尼也沒有取得任何可以向東方交代的戰果。戰爭沒有就此結束：公元前36年之戰讓安東尼再攻亞美尼亞，公元前38年帕科魯斯戰死吉爾達魯斯山，公元前39年安息歸還鷹旗並承認提格列斯四世為亞美尼亞王，第一輪羅馬與安息的角力才以安東尼失敗、羅馬保住亞美尼亞收場。
resultEn: The result divides into a tactical outcome and a campaign outcome. Tactically Antony took Artaxata: after a siege lasting months the gates opened, King Artavasdes II and the royal household were captured, and the Romans occupied the old capital of Armenia, so the losing side gave up both its city and its king. As a campaign, however, it was a complete failure. Antony abandoned the advance toward Ecbatana, the Parthian horse attacked the rearguard and the baggage train during the withdrawal, the towers, rams, onagers and the whole grain convoy were destroyed or carried off, and the Roman army reached the eastern Mediterranean with no siege capability at all. Neither Parthian territory nor Mesopotamia was touched, and Antony gained nothing he could show in the East. The war did not end there: the fighting of 36 BC had Antony strike at Armenia again, Pacorus fell at Mount Gindarus in 38 BC, and in 39 BC Parthia returned the eagle standards and recognised Tigranes IV as king of Armenia, so that the first round of the Roman-Parthian contest closed with Antony defeated but Rome holding on to Armenia.
